cases.title: Dense header and field actions invite adjacent mis-taps
acceptance: Measured external gaps are≥8dp in native screenshots/hierarchy.
320dp layout reflows without reducing target sizes or spacing.

cases.title: Large type on a narrow screen clips the role and spills the gate icon
acceptance: At320dp width and150% type, full role is readable and no icon/text crosses its target.
All tab labels remain distinguishable; inspect at200% separately.

cases.title: Raw enums and mixed language leak into operational screens
acceptance: Each currently observed enum renders a Vietnamese business label on list/detail/confirmation screens.
Known backend English notification templates are localized or clearly marked language-specific.

cases.title: Seal checks still ask for damage severity
acceptance: Seal and condition checks show relevant fields/copy only.
Damage surveys retain their current severity choices and submitted notes.

cases.title: Inspection history starts with a false empty message
acceptance: Under a delayed GET, history shows loading rather than empty.
Under a failed GET, history shows a local retry; successful empty/populated results are distinct.

cases.title: Unread total is passed but never rendered
acceptance: Native header/content shows the server unread count for zero and nonzero states.
Mark-read actions update the displayed count; verify with authorized fixture state.

cases.title: Booking date requires a manually formatted timestamp
acceptance: User can enter a valid date/time without recalling separators.
Helper/timezone remains visible after entry and validation points to this field.

cases.title: Theme selection resets to light when the session reloads
acceptance: Choose dark, close/reopen the app and retain dark with the existing auth session.
Initial unconfigured appearance follows the selected documented default/system preference.

cases.title: Missing-field error remains after both survey fields are filled
acceptance: Blank review produces clear field-specific messages.
Filling each required field removes its missing-field error before another submit; server failures remain visible.

cases.title: Shared card headings are plain Text without heading semantics
acceptance: TalkBack heading navigation reaches each meaningful card/title once in logical order.
Ordinary content and controls remain individually reachable.

cases.title: Shared header/layout repeat values outside existing tokens
acceptance: Affected consumers reference named tokens; literals are limited to token definitions and documented geometry.
Preserve existing layout and test both themes plus320dp/font scale1.5.

cases.title: Logout could be undone by a late token refresh or cleanup.
Late old cache writes/clears could remove a newer same-user cache.
